verdict.rationale: Sumsub's docs show substantial no-code configuration surface: verification levels can be built and edited via UI (even via plain-language AI level builder, sumsub-docs-36), AML screening lists/fuzziness are configurable (sumsub-docs-6/37), client lists enable flexible flow/blocklist rules (sumsub-docs-34), and branding/SDK text/templates are editable without engineering deploy (sumsub-docs-7/18/29/30). However, there is no explicit documentation of conditional branching logic or country-specific requirement rules as a distinct no-code feature — only general level/step configuration and document coverage across 220+ countries (sumsub-docs-11) is mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit conditional-step/branching UI documentation, explicit risk-based routing configuration feature, explicit country-specific rule-setting UI evidence.
